object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

Just-In-Time deprovisioning failed for entitlement ${entitlementName} for identity ${identityName}.

The user's access may still be active. Please review to block or revoke the access in $__global.productName.

#if($activationUrl)

Manage Just-In-Time access here.

#end

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies administrators when Just-In-Time deprovisioning fails and the user's privileged access may remain active.
object.name: Just-In-Time Deprovisioning Failed
object.subject: Just-In-Time deprovisioning failed for ${entitlementName}
